**The Bridge with an Open End**
A short bridge of woven light ends a few steps before a solid terrace. Volunteer binder Ada has left it unfinished rather than pull the far end tight enough to bow the handrails. Travellers have begun treating it as a lookout. Her workbench holds two plans: a perfect straight crossing and a slightly crooked one with room to settle.

options.label: Inspect the crooked plan with Ada
options.description: Gain 5% temporary defense; approach the far end.

options.description: Use the research allowance; approach the far end.

**The Bridge with an Open End**
At the open end, a loose thread has caught around an old visitor’s walking mark. Ada remembers the visitor offering help, then leaving after she insisted on finishing alone. The thread is sound. It only needs someone on the terrace to hold a gentle curve while the near end is tied.

Three broad steps float at different angles over a public exercise yard. Gathered wild companions use them to practise changing direction without abandoning a teammate. A steward can teach the handrail route slowly, or introduce the waiting challengers one after another. Both routes finish on the same wide, steady terrace.
